concepts.name: 황금 메달
concepts.design: A large thick gold reward medallion floats upright 0.6 metres above a low brass-rimmed pedestal. Bold embossed upward arrow on its face, small cyan enamel accent, one clean thin circular golden halo behind it, slow rotation implied by a single arc. No swarm of tiny stars. On pickup the medallion dissolves into three gold streaks pulled into the shark and one crisp expanding gold ring at chest height.
concepts.build: Unity mesh + existing coin materials + short ring particles
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE polished landscape game-VFX concept presentation sheet for a real portrait Unity mobile runner, using the provided screenshot only as the environment, camera, shark character and rendering-style reference. The screenshot's current tiny star particles and empty wooden pads are rejected. Keep the same bright stylized harbor wooden pier, cyan sea, fish stalls and gray shark with white/cyan sneakers, cel shading and thin dark outlines. This is a feasible real-time Unity effect design, not painted fantasy spectacle. Layout: navy/ivory minimal presentation border; a large left panel labelled '대기' showing TWO choice pedestals in the familiar elevated gameplay camera, with the same designed reward object on each pedestal. Preserve ample clear space around the readable existing '보너스' / '+14%' / '공격력' world label; the actual reward object is large enough to read at mobile distance but only about half the shark's height. Right panel labelled '획득' shows the SAME shark at the pickup moment, with the reward object disappearing and the effect described below. Reward VFX is focal and clearly visible. Do not invent extra menu buttons or unrelated HUD. Equal exposure and consistent harbor background across both panels. Use restrained mobile-game emissive shading, no scene-filling bloom, no smoke or toxic green, no giant opaque clumps of stars. Text: exact Korean top title given below, small top-right '구현 가능 시안'. No other English or explanatory text baked into image. Subject design follows:

concepts.name: 항구의 진주
concepts.design: An open ivory scallop shell on the pedestal holds a large luminous pearl, pale warm white centre and subtle cyan rim, one gentle orbiting glint. Recognizably a valuable pearl rather than a magical poison sphere. On pickup a clean pearlescent bubble halo expands around the shark with six tiny water diamonds and a soft pearl-white flash. No smoke.

concepts.name: 보물상자
concepts.design: A compact rounded wooden treasure chest with chunky brass bands sits slightly open on the pedestal. Warm golden light leaks through the lid opening, with a clear golden upward reward emblem hovering above it. On pickup its lid springs open and six gold coins arc into the shark, accompanied by one brief gold sunburst. Clearly friendly collectible treasure, not a combat explosion.
